brief_text: Use gravity 9.81 m/s2, contact friction 0.68, restitution 0.05, hinge damping 0.04 N m s/rad, and slide damping 0.20 N s/m; start every body from rest. Balls are 0.10 m diameter and 0.20 kg, dominoes are 0.08 by 0.04 by 0.24 m and 0.25 kg, carts are 0.22 by 0.18 by 0.10 m and 0.50 kg, blocks are 0.12 m cubes and 0.35 kg, ramps are 0.95 m long and 0.30 m wide at 19 degrees, and horizontal rings have 0.16 m clear diameter. Pendulum1 is a 0.55 m long, 0.40 kg rigid pendulum released 55 degrees left of vertical, and it swings clockwise to touch ball1 at the high end of ramp1. Ball1 rolls down ramp1, whose low end is 0.15 m above the floor, crosses a 0.12 m gap, and touches cart1.

usage.text:
```xml
<mujoco model="pendulum_ball_ramp_cart">
  <compiler angle="degree" autolimits="true"/>
  <option timestep="0.002" gravity="0 0 -9.81" integrator="implicitfast" cone="elliptic" iterations="80"/>
  <size njmax="300" nconmax="100"/>

  <!-- Nominal restitution 0.05 is approximated by the linear-contact damping ratio 0.690106. -->
  <!-- Sliding friction is 0.68 throughout. Small rolling resistance on the receiving surfaces lets the ball settle. -->

  <visual>
    <headlight ambient="0.4 0.4 0.4" diffuse="0.7 0.7 0.7" specular="0.2 0.2 0.2"/>
    <map znear="0.01"/>
  </visual>

  <worldbody>
    <light name="main_light" pos="0.8 -2 3" dir="0 0 -1"/>
    <camera name="overview" pos="1 -3.8 1.8" xyaxes="1 0 0 0 0.30 0.954"/>

    <geom name="floor" type="plane" size="4 3 0.1" friction="0.68 0.005 0.002" condim="6" priority="1" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.78 0.80 0.82 1"/>

    <!-- The 0.95 m top surface descends 19 degrees; its low endpoint is (0.898243, 0, 0.15). -->
    <body name="ramp1" pos="0.442609960 0 0.285734502" euler="0 19 0">
      <geom name="ramp1_surface" type="box" size="0.475 0.15 0.02" friction="0.68 0.005 0.0001" condim="3" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.57 0.36 0.19 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- A 0.55 m rigid pendulum, measured from hinge to the lowest tip, with total mass 0.40 kg. -->
    <!-- The negative initial hinge angle places it left of vertical; gravity swings it toward +x. -->
    <body name="pendulum1" pos="0.20 0 0.975">
      <joint name="pendulum1_hinge" type="hinge" axis="0 -1 0" damping="0.04"/>
      <geom name="pendulum1_rod" type="capsule" fromto="0 0 -0.015 0 0 -0.50" size="0.012" mass="0.10" friction="0.68 0.005 0.0001" condim="3" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.25 0.29 0.34 1"/>
      <geom name="pendulum1_tip" type="sphere" pos="0 0 -0.52" size="0.03" mass="0.30" friction="0.68 0.005 0.0001" condim="3" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.70 0.15 0.12 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- Ball starts 0.06 m down the ramp, at rest and tangent to its top surface. -->
    <body name="ball1" pos="0.073009522 0 0.487031586">
      <freejoint name="ball1_free"/>
      <geom name="ball1_sphere" type="sphere" size="0.05" mass="0.20" friction="0.68 0.005 0.0001" condim="3" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.96 0.70 0.08 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- The cart's initial front face is 0.12 m beyond the ramp's low endpoint. -->
    <!-- The slide joint supports the cart vertically; rails sit 1 mm beneath it. -->
    <body name="cart1" pos="1.128242647 0 0.09">
      <joint name="cart1_slide" type="slide" axis="1 0 0" damping="0.20" limited="true" range="0 0.45" solreflimit="0.008 1" solimplimit="0.95 0.95 0.001"/>
      <geom name="cart1_chassis" type="box" size="0.11 0.09 0.05" mass="0.50" friction="0.68 0.005 0.002" condim="6" priority="1" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.10 0.35 0.75 1"/>
    </body>

    <body name="cart_track" pos="1.428242647 0 0">
      <geom name="cart_track_left_rail" type="box" pos="0 0.07 0.0195" size="0.41 0.015 0.0195" friction="0.68 0.005 0.002" condim="6" priority="1" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.30 0.33 0.37 1"/>
      <geom name="cart_track_right_rail" type="box" pos="0 -0.07 0.0195" size="0.41 0.015 0.0195" friction="0.68 0.005 0.002" condim="6" priority="1" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.30 0.33 0.37 1"/>
    </body>

    <!-- A passive receiving stop confines the ball after its encounter with the cart. -->
    <body name="receiving_stop" pos="1.885 0 0.18">
      <geom name="receiving_stop_wall" type="box" size="0.035 0.20 0.18" friction="0.68 0.005 0.002" condim="6" priority="1" solref="0.008 0.690106" solimp="0.95 0.95 0.001" rgba="0.25 0.42 0.28 1"/>
    </body>
  </worldbody>

  <!-- Keyframe hinge coordinates are radians, despite compiler angle="degree". All velocities are zero. -->
  <keyframe>
    <key name="start" qpos="-0.959931089 0.073009522 0 0.487031586 1 0 0 0 0" qvel="0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0"/>
  </keyframe>
</mujoco>
```

Yes—the run completes the requested interaction sequence.

Pendulum1 starts from rest, 55° left of vertical, and swings toward ball1, striking it near ramp1’s high end at **0.35 s**. After briefly lifting off and landing again, it rolls down the ramp, leaves the low end at **0.80 s**, crosses the gap, and touches cart1 at **0.83 s**.

Cart1 slides forward and reaches its upper stop. Ball1 subsequently drops onto the floor and comes to rest at approximately **1.47 s**, remaining at rest through **6 s**. Pendulum1 continues oscillating, which the brief does not prohibit.
